WITH s1 AS (SELECT link_to_major AS m, COUNT(*) AS c FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major),
s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM s1),
s3 AS (SELECT s1.m AS m, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.total, 0) AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL),
s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_c FROM s3)
SELECT s3.m, s3.c, s3.share, CAST(s3.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s4.avg_c, 0) AS ratio
FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.avg_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
